comment: Development-toolchain advisories the release check may pass while they stand. Each entry needs a reason and an expiry; an expired entry fails the check. Production (npm audit --omit=dev) has no exceptions.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists (<=3.0.3 is every version). It reaches the toolchain only through tailwindcss 3 (chokidar, micromatch), fast-glob and @next/eslint-plugin-next, which expand this repository's own build and lint patterns, never request input. Remove when braces publishes a fix or Tailwind 4 lands.
